from time import perf_counter from unittest import TestCase from mistune import create_markdown from mistune.toc import add_toc_hook, render_toc_ul class TestAutoseIssue4E2E(TestCase): def test_render_toc_ul_ordered_and_unordered(self): # AC-FR-001-1: ordered single item toc_items_1 = [(1, 'toc_1', 'Introduction')] self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc_items_1, ordered=True), '
    \n
  1. Introduction
    2. \n
\n' ) # AC-FR-001-2: ordered nested items toc_items_2 = [(1, 'toc_1', 'One'), (2, 'toc_2', 'Sub')] self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc_items_2, ordered=True), '
    \n
  1. One\n
      \n
    1. Sub
      2. \n
    \n
    2. \n
\n' ) # AC-FR-002-1: unordered default self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc_items_1), '
    \n
  • Introduction
    • \n
\n' ) # AC-FR-002-2: unordered explicit self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc_items_1, ordered=False), '
    \n
  • Introduction
    • \n
\n' ) def test_toc_performance(self): # AC-NFR-001-1: < 5ms for 1000 TOC items toc_items = [(i % 3 + 1, f"toc_{i}", f"Heading {i}") for i in range(1000)] start = perf_counter() result = render_toc_ul(toc_items, ordered=True) duration = perf_counter() - start self.assertTrue(result) self.assertLess(duration, 0.005) # less than 5ms def test_regression_empty_and_complex_unordered_toc(self): # Regression test 1: empty and filtered TOC self.assertEqual(render_toc_ul([]), "") self.assertEqual(render_toc_ul(filter(lambda _: False, [])), "") # Regression test 2: complex multi-level unordered TOC rendering toc_items = [ (1, 'h1', 'Heading 1'), (2, 'h2', 'Heading 2'), (3, 'h3', 'Heading 3'), (1, 'h1-2', 'Heading 1.2'), ] expected = ( '
    \n' '
  • Heading 1\n' '
      \n' '
    • Heading 2\n' '
        \n' '
      • Heading 3
        • \n' '
      \n' '
      • \n' '
    \n' '
    • \n' '
  • Heading 1.2
    • \n' '
\n' ) self.assertEqual(render_toc_ul(toc_items, ordered=False), expected) def test_regression_markdown_toc_hook_integration(self): # Regression test 3: Markdown parser integration with toc hook md = create_markdown(escape=False) add_toc_hook(md) html, state = md.parse("# Introduction\n\n## Sub") toc_html = render_toc_ul(state.env["toc_items"], ordered=True) self.assertIn('
    ', toc_html) self.assertIn('Introduction', toc_html) self.assertIn('Sub', toc_html)
